analyst: Manual analysis using Claude Opus 5.5 for verification and code analysis

servers.server_cost: "ChatGPT / Claude MCP" included in all plans at no extra charge; sending SMS via the AI assistant needs pre-paid credits
servers.linked_cost: Starter $19/$15, Business $33/$23, Scale $47/$35 per user/month (monthly/annual); automation credits (1,000 free = 10 Sona AI agent calls; packages $25-$199/month); automated SMS via API $0.01 per segment
servers.pricing: Per-user plans + credits for automation and SMS
servers.restrictions: Clients: Claude all users, ChatGPT Plus and Pro, Grok users. SMS only with pre-paid credits. Transcripts only on numbers where enabled.
servers.governance_logic: 1) Pre-paid credits limit SMS sending by the agent. 2) OAuth scopes broader than the documentation (write:calls, read:agents, write:agents) - needs checking. 3) Confirmation before sending, bulk limits and logging not described.
servers.actions_comment: Not published; 6 capability groups in the docs (summaries, sending SMS, messages/inboxes, calls/transcripts, contacts, missed calls); scopes also point to call writing and AI agents
servers.agent_cannot: Make calls (not stated in docs, although write:calls exists); manage numbers, users, billing; send SMS without credits.
servers.docs_recs: None; nothing about confirming messages before sending.
servers.gov_promises: Not described in the MCP docs (link to the privacy policy). The agent has access to customer conversations and call transcripts (third-party personal data).
servers.promises_vs_logic: OAuth scopes reveal more capabilities (calls, AI agents) than the documentation describes.
servers.notes: Quo = formerly OpenPhone. Official connector for Claude, ChatGPT, Grok. Actions reconstructed from documentation capability groups and OAuth scopes.

Tools.desc: Conversation summaries; sending SMS to one or several people; message history and inboxes (filters by contact, date, topic); call history and voicemail transcripts; search, add, change contacts; missed calls. Exact names not published.

Authorization.desc: OAuth; metadata documents published; DCR (https://mcp.quo.com/register); grants authorization_code, refresh_token; PKCE S256; client methods client_secret_basic, client_secret_post, none; 8 scopes: read:conversations, write:conversations, read:calls, write:calls, write:contacts, read:account, read:agents, write:agents

actions.desc: Send SMS to one or several people on behalf of the company (needs pre-paid credits)
Read message history and inboxes (filters by contact, date, topic)
Read call history and voicemail transcripts
Write access to calls - not described in the documentation (needs checking)
Access to Quo AI agents (e.g. Sona) - not described in the documentation (needs checking)

observations.text: The agent communicates with external people on behalf of the company (SMS, bulk sends) without a described confirmation step - one of the riskiest real-world actions in this set.
Divergence between scopes and documentation: the OAuth metadata reveals more capabilities than described.
Paying for the agent's actions with credits - an economic limiter.
